sources.name: materials
sources.prompt: Image 1 is the old production sheet, preserve its exact grid, every object's identity, order and orientation. Image 2 is the USER-APPROVED Brainstorm Haven office reference and is the art/design authority. Rebuild image 1 in image 2's flat 2D cut-paper cartoon game look: bold clean charcoal/brown outlines, simple deliberate shapes, mostly solid muted sage, green, tan, brown, teal and warm cream colors, one or two flat shadow planes only. No anime painting, watercolor, detailed grain, photorealism, shiny 3D bevels or noisy micro-detail. Wherever an object appears in image 2 copy its exact shape, palette and simple detailing. Match the old round-eyed paper cartoon characters' visual world. This is an actual reusable game sprite sheet, NOT a screenshot, room scene, concept board or generic UI icon set. No people, captions, labels, logos, grid lines or watermark. EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows of edge-to-edge seamless repeatable top-down terrain tiles. Row1 four natural warm-gray/tan stone path slab variations with dark simple seam lines. Row2 solid green grass with a few tiny flat grass tufts, cream sand with sparse simple marks, turquoise water with clean flat wave shapes, brown corral earth. Row3 golden tan wide horizontal floorboards EXACTLY matching approved office floor with fine dark seams but no wood grain, darker walnut floorboards same simple language, solid sage/cream plaster, simple terracotta roof shingles. Row4 flat gray road with a few sparse marks, simple mossy cobbles, flat golden straw, simple brown timber planks. Every individual cell fills its edges, no margins or padding, no separating grid. Opposite edges of EACH cell must tile seamlessly. Uniform flat illumination, no cast light or shadows spanning an entire cell. Restrained simple broad shapes. Output opaque complete sheet.
